scripts.build: npm run build:shared && concurrently --names backend,frontend -c "#f20,#0a0" --prefix "[{name}]" "npm run build:backend" "npm run build:frontend"
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --names backend,frontend,shared -c "#f20,#0a0,#ea0" --prefix "[{name}]" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:shared"
scripts.start: npm run build:shared && concurrently --names backend,frontend -c "#f20,#0a0" --prefix "[{name}]" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
